name: 云底高度（抬升凝结高度）估算

map.由气温与露点差，按经验规则 H ≈ (T − Td) × 125（米/℃）估算云: Estimate the cloud base height from the air temperature − dew point spread using the empirical rule H ≈ (T − Td) × 125 (m/°C).
map.云底高度（抬升凝结高度）估算: Cloud Base Height (Lifting Condensation Level) Estimation
map.📖 查看「云底高度 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Cloud Base Height User Guide"
map.经验规则（约 125 m/℃），与气压、抬升率有关，作近似。: Empirical rule (about 125 m/°C), related to pressure and lifting rate; an approximation.
map.由气温与露点温差估云底离地高度。: Estimate the cloud base height above ground from the temperature-dew point spread.
map.航空/通航判断云底是否够低影响起降。: For aviation/general aviation, judge whether the cloud base is low enough to affect takeoff and landing.
map.预报员用干湿球差快速估云高。: Forecasters use the dry-wet bulb difference to quickly estimate cloud height.
map.温差估云高: Estimating cloud height from the temperature spread
map.=10/2.5×1000=4000 ft≈1220 m（经验率每温差 1°C 约: =10/2.5×1000=4000 ft≈1220 m (empirical rate about 400 ft per 1°C of spread).
map.温差仅 2°C → 云底≈800 ft≈240 m，属低云，通航需谨慎。: Spread only 2°C → cloud base ≈800 ft≈240 m, a low cloud; general aviation should be cautious.
map.2.5 这个系数是哪来的？: Where does the coefficient 2.5 come from?
map.干绝热(9.8°C/km)与露点直减(约 2°C/km)之差约 8°C/km，换: The difference between the dry adiabatic lapse rate (9.8°C/km) and the dew-point lapse rate (about 2°C/km) is about 8°C/km, which converts to about 125 m per °C of spread; empirically 122 m (400 ft) is used.
map.云底高度准吗？: Is the cloud base height accurate?
map.是近似，假设云由地面空气抬升凝结而成；层云较准，积云因对流会偏低。: It is an approximation assuming clouds form from surface air lifted and condensed; it is fairly accurate for stratus, while cumulus tends to be lower due to convection.
